title: Home Delivery Pharmacy and Specialty Pharmacy Program: Down-Payment Reduction for Members Owing Specialty Balances
content:
## Cross-benefit coordination note: specialty balances and the home delivery down payment

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, the down-payment rate is reduced when the member also owes Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy: by 5 points when the balance due on the member's active specialty enrollment is 250.00 or more, by 2.5 points when that balance is above zero but under 250.00, and not at all when nothing is owed there.

The balance read is the balance due on the member's active Specialty Pharmacy Program enrollment; a point is one percentage point of the down-payment rate.

### Reduction by specialty balance

| Balance due on the active Specialty Pharmacy Program enrollment | Reduction of the down-payment rate |
|---|---|
| 250.00 or more | 5 points |
| above zero, under 250.00 | 2.5 points |
| zero, or no active specialty enrollment | none |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical balances)

- 250.00: 5 points. 249.99: 2.5 points.
- 0.01: 2.5 points. 0.00: none.
